name: evaluate
title: Evaluate
description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the tab context and return the result. An expression that is exactly one function (an arrow or function expression, async included) is called and its result returned; anything else, including an IIFE that is already invoked, runs as written. A page-side exception fails with SCRIPT_ERROR carrying its message. A session launched with disable_evaluate: true rejects this call with EVALUATE_DISABLED.
